display_long_description:
1XR is an immersive virtual reality training platform designed to deliver interactive learning experiences in VR.

Using realistic 360° environments, users can explore training scenarios while answering timed questions and completing guided learning modules. The platform is designed for educational institutions, corporate training programs, and professional development.

Key features include:

• Immersive 360° VR training experiences  
• Interactive questions integrated into video scenarios  
• Real-time knowledge assessment during training  
• Secure user authentication and progress tracking  
• Cloud-delivered streaming experiences  
• Tenant-based branding for organizations and training providers  

1XR allows organizations to deliver engaging and scalable VR training experiences directly to Meta Quest devices.

This application requires a user account provided by an authorized organization.

For more information, visit:
https://urview.com
